What is Surfer?

Content optimisation platform that analyses the top-ranking pages for a keyword and gives a real-time content score as you write, guiding word count, headings, terms and structure toward what is actually ranking.

Best for

Optimising individual pages against live SERP data while writing.

Main features

  • Content Editor with a live optimisation score as you type
  • SERP Analyzer comparing 500+ on-page signals against top-ranking pages
  • Content Audit for existing pages with prioritised fixes
  • Keyword Research with topic clustering and search-intent classification
  • Surfer AI generating a fully optimised article draft
  • AI Humanizer
  • internal linking suggestions
  • Grow Flow weekly task recommendations
  • Google Docs and WordPress integration
  • AI Tracker monitoring brand visibility in AI answer engines.

Practical use cases

  • Writing or rewriting a page to match what is ranking for a target keyword
  • auditing an underperforming page and getting a prioritised fix list
  • building a topic cluster plan from keyword research
  • briefing freelance writers with a concrete optimisation target.

Who is it for?

  • SEO specialists, content marketers, agencies and in-house content teams.

Pricing, free access & limits

Subscription by content credits and seats; Surfer AI articles priced separately

Plans described in the source

Essential around $99/mo ($79 annually) with roughly 30 content editor credits/month and 1 seat. Scale around $219/mo ($175 annually) with more credits and seats. Enterprise custom, annual, with unlimited credits, white-labelling and a dedicated manager. Surfer AI article generation is charged separately, historically around $19-29 per article or in bundled packs. Annual billing roughly 20% cheaper.

Free plan

No free plan.

Free trial

Yes - 7-day money-back guarantee rather than a true free trial; occasional limited trials offered.

Usage limits to consider

Content editor credits metered per month - each optimised article or audit consumes a credit. Surfer AI articles are an additional cost on top of the subscription. Seat counts and tracked domains are tier-limited.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • The live content score while writing is the most actionable optimisation feedback in this group - writers actually use it, which is not true of most SEO tools
  • SERP Analyzer's breadth of signals is genuinely deep
  • the AI Tracker for answer-engine visibility is forward-looking
  • Google Docs integration means writers stay in their tool.

Limitations to consider

  • Expensive at $99/mo entry for what is fundamentally a single-purpose tool
  • the content score encourages formulaic writing that hits targets without being better - over-optimisation is a real risk
  • Surfer AI articles cost extra on top of an already high subscription
  • credit metering frustrates high-volume teams
  • correlation-based recommendations are not causal, and Surfer does not claim otherwise.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, Chrome extension, Google Docs add-on, WordPress plugin

Languages

  • Supports optimisation in many languages including French; Arabic support exists but SERP analysis quality is weaker for Arabic queries

API access

Yes - Surfer API available on higher tiers

Integrations and exports

  • Google Docs, WordPress, Jasper, Contentful, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Zapier, Webflow

Evaluation notes

Treat the content score as a floor, not a target - articles written purely to maximise the score read poorly and increasingly underperform as search engines weight quality signals. Budget for Surfer AI articles separately; they are not included.
